snippet.title: Locally Sourced Anthology II: The Timeline - Coming Soon!
snippet.description:
Locally Sourced Anthology II: The Timeline is a collection of 5 experimental games that takes you on a journey through time!

Coming soon to Steam and itch.io!

Wishlist here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3938610/Locally_Sourced_Anthology_II_The_Timeline/

Find all of our socials and discord here: https://locallysourced.carrd.co/
